short: framework objects and their line formats
is: The backend-blind types (tickets, epics, tasks, asks, answers, findings, instances, profiles, ids, labels, the machine budget and build slot, the scheduling core) and the text formats they travel in, each with its parser, plus the verbatim quote check.
conventions: Imports no other layer, only the crate's text_newtype macro; zaf/tests/architecture.rs fails on a break
A format with rules gets its own error type (AskError, AnswerError, IdError, TaskTemplateError)

fs.name: answer.rs
fs.role: keeper answer: verdict, citations, word limit

fs.name: ask.rs
fs.role: ask record: up to five typed questions

fs.name: budget.rs
fs.role: the machine budget: whether a launch fits the machine and its project, in units a task size costs (`[spawn] budget` in the zaf home)

fs.name: document_signature.rs
fs.role: a release document's signature block (`---`, signed, hash, `---`) at its top: read it (signed, unsigned, or malformed with its line), sign a document, and cut the body below it; the hash is BodyHash::of that body

fs.name: epic.rs
fs.role: the Epic entity and its stage derived on read (unsigned, signed, planned, challenged, done), its tasks, and the BodyHash a signature holds; the release an epic is of (the `Release: <version>` first line of its body: release_of, Epic::release, of_version) and the NewEpic a board files

fs.name: ids.rs
fs.role: ticket ids, page ids and commit ids

fs.name: instance.rs
fs.role: a role run numbered on its epic, and its slug

fs.name: memory.rs
fs.role: memory as the budget counts it: mebibytes read from the machine, and the units the budget is written in

fs.name: profile.rs
fs.role: context profiles: lean, build, design, review

fs.name: quote.rs
fs.role: verbatim quote check against the cited page

fs.name: schedule.rs
fs.role: the scheduling core, pure, read only by the shadow placement so far (app/schedule): where each ticket sits from facts alone (place, Placement), its current phase (an `exit` phase at or before the `pr-open` one not keyed on the head), what a run meant (outcome), getting nowhere, the lane and its weight (a priority/1 to priority/3 label worth three to one hours of age, read from labels by Priority::from_labels), the order of merges (a ticket fresh from a fix first, a pending integration branch holds the next), overdue and dead waits, the challenge deadline, and the state label as output; ActionName, PhaseEnd and CheckName live here

fs.name: schedule/
fs.role: facts, phase, outcome, place, lane, merge, wait and label, each with a tests.rs; tests.rs holds the parity table against today's rule table and the eight failures of 2026-11-12

fs.name: slot.rs
fs.role: the record a slotted gate run keeps while it holds the machine's build slot

fs.name: task.rs
fs.role: task ticket template: one Field: value per line

fs.name: ticket.rs
fs.role: the Ticket entity, its title, body and link newtypes, the TicketSummary every --json prints, Standing with how an issue stands from open, dropped and done, StandingAt (with when it closed) and OpenTicket (an open task with its priority label and when it opened)

notes: Task fields: Goal, Scope with Out of scope (or Owned paths; Scope wins when both are given), Interfaces, Design pages, Architecture (optional), Acceptance, Tests, Security trigger, Model, Size; check reads Tests, Architecture and Acceptance
Task labels ready, claimed, blocked, question, done and page statuses decided, current, proposed, superseded are the vocabularies shared with the board and design source
Ask kinds are fact, rule, term, exists, where
